question.text: The ratio of spin-only magnetic moment values  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">μ</mi><mi>eff</mi></msub><msup><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mi>Cr</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>CN</mi><msub><mo>)</mo><mn>6</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo>/</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">μ</mi><mi>eff</mi></msub><msup><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mi>Cr</mi><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfenced><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> is _______

solution.text:
In case of Cr3+ ion , the valence shell electronic configuration is same whether the ligand is strong field or weak field.

The spin only magnetic moment , μeff=nn+2BM

The valence shell electronic configuration of Cr3+ is 3d3, hence, it has three unpaired electrons.

μeff  of Cr(CN)6-3=15 B.M. 

μeff of CrH2O6+3=15 B.M. 

Ratio = 1
